newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dominion Resources raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dominion Resources raised.

text.p: -- Furman Selz said on Thursday it had raised its rating for Dominion Resources Inc to buy from hold and placed the company's stock on its recommended list.

-- Analyst Andrew Levi wrote in a report he expected Dominion's $2.2 billion offer for Britain's East Midlands Electricity Plc to be approved by British regulators and not be referred to the monopolies and mergers commission.
-- "We believe this positive announcement will lead to higher earnings in 1997 and 1998," he said.
-- He maintained Dominion's earnings per share estimate of $3.03, $3.40 and $3.65 for 1996, 1997 and 1998, respectively. The 12-18 month price target is $44 a share.
